@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B406Z7RVSBJKKJ8KJW0CY2
+- 01M4B40CFSF002B4DKM3T8J6GV
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 9b80
+title: 'Errors: codes and corrective messages'
+---
+## What
+One catalog for all error codes and their messages. The basis is plan.md §4.4.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/GraphQL/Errors.swift`: one Swift type for each code: `INVALID_VARIABLES`, `NOT_FOUND`, `AMBIGUOUS_ID`, `ACTOR_NOT_FOUND`, `DUPLICATE_ID`, `COLUMN_NOT_EMPTY`, `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`, `TAG_RENAME_CYCLE`, `NOTHING_TO_UNDO`, `UNDO_CONFLICT`, `INVALID_FILTER`, `INVALID_TAG_NAME`, `INVALID_SLUG`, `INVALID_ORDINAL`, `BOARD_BUSY`, `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_IN_TOOL`.
+- Each error has `message`, `path`, and `extensions.code`. Each message tells the model how to correct the call (for example `AMBIGUOUS_ID` lists the matching short ids; `NOT_FOUND` for a board lists the search roots).
+- Change the existing throw sites of the mutation and filter code to use this catalog.
+- The tool never throws for a GraphQL error; it returns the response JSON.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each code has one test that makes it happen through `execute`.
+- [ ] Each message has a correction (a test checks that each message has a suggestion or an example).
+- [ ] A failed field gives `data` for the other fields and one item in `errors`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/GraphQL/ErrorCatalogTests.swift`: one test for each code (codes for later features, such as `UNDO_CONFLICT` and `SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_IN_TOOL`, are tested in their own tasks; this task tests the message format for them).
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter ErrorCatalogTests`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
